title: Venture Frost — Startup KPI Grid
description: A regimented grid of uniform frosted tiles built for board-update decks that must carry real metrics without collapsing into a spreadsheet. Distinct from decorative glass templates in that every frosting, spacing, and typographic choice is subordinated to data legibility.
philosophy: This template exists for the moment a founder stands in front of investors and needs the numbers to speak before any word is said. It refuses ornamental glasswork — translucency here is structural, creating visual depth that separates tiles from the gradient field without adding noise. Typography is deliberately utilitarian: tabular, monospaced-feeling numerals only, zero serifs, zero display flourish. The single accent color is rationed to one semantic job — positive delta — because spending it decoratively destroys its signal value entirely.
goodFor: Board update decks surfacing 4–6 live KPIs per slide
MRR, ARR, churn, and growth-rate callout slides
Weekly or monthly performance reviews with sparkline trend context
Investor data rooms requiring strict number hierarchy and fast scanning
avoidFor: Narrative or story-first slides where data is secondary to a single message
Chart-heavy quarterly reviews mixing bar charts, pies, and tables on one canvas
Brand launch or product reveal slides requiring emotional visual tension
Academic or research presentations needing footnotes, citations, or dense body copy
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide carries the cold authority of a war-room dashboard at midnight — frosted tile geometry looms as structural promise in the background, depth created by translucency layered over a gradient field. Compositional rhythm is asymmetric and grounded: heavy typographic mass lower-left, airy negative space upper-right. The mood is institutional precision without sterility — urgent readiness, not ceremony. Avoid decorative glow, illustrative elements, or visual warmth that would soften the data-first commitment.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; title text anchors in cols 2–7, vertically positioned in the lower-left quadrant to create upward negative space. A sparse 2×2 cluster of ghost frosted tiles occupies cols 8–11 at reduced opacity, foreshadowing the KPI grid without activating it. Subtitle sits one clear typographic step below the title via weight contrast alone — no rule lines or dividers. Outer margin holds at 8% on all sides; deck identifier floats as a small caption in the top-right corner with no additional framing.

examples.promptCore: The slide reads like a mission-control dashboard — clinically ordered, cold-lit, built for fast scanning under pressure rather than leisurely browsing. Frosted tile faces float above the gradient field through shallow translucency, creating structural depth without decorative noise. The compositional rhythm is dense-modular: each tile is a self-contained unit of meaning, and visual hierarchy is enforced entirely by numeral dominance and the rationed accent reserved for positive-delta signals. Avoid any ornamental glass effects, glow halos, or layered transparency on tile surfaces — every element that doesn't serve data legibility must be removed.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with 6 uniform frosted tiles in a 2-row × 3-column arrangement, each tile occupying 4 columns with consistent inter-tile gutters and an 8% outer margin on all sides. A slim header row spanning the full 12 columns carries the slide label and reporting period, separated from the tile grid by a single hairline rule. Inside each tile, elements stack vertically: metric label at top, dominant figure centered, inline delta badge to its right, and a sparkline strip pinned to the tile's bottom edge. Slide number is anchored bottom-right, outside the tile grid entirely.
